ops.title: Performance pack denies whole-root content searches and raw git cat-file -e (v12.102.0)
ops.body:
PR #401 (merge 08a8ea29, tag v12.102.0) adds two pack-local PreToolUse Bash guards.

search.py: a recursive grep/ugrep/rg rooted at /, a home, a repository root (stat of .git/.jj on the glob prefix), a .claude/worktrees or .orca/workspaces pool (and one repo's pool inside it), or a scratch root (**/.claude/scratch, TEMP_ROOTS) or its first level is denied. Named files (including an existing regular file), a deeper directory, or a search whose every positive include narrows (contains a letter or digit) still runs. Bare */**, negative globs, excludes, max-count, depth, | head, rg -t all, --type-add, ugrep -M/--include-from/--all are not bounds. rg with piped or redirected stdin (not /dev/null, not -f -) and rg --files are exempt. The guard never expands globs or walks trees.

git_objects.py: git cat-file -e without --no-lazy-fetch or a GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH prefix is denied; points at git --no-lazy-fetch cat-file --batch-check and test -e.

Why pack-local: activation on the live 12.101.15 host was an atomic file overlay into ~/.daemonkit/tools/capt-hook/12.101.15/capt-hook/lib/python3.13/site-packages/captain_hook/builtin_packs/performance/hooks/ (owner chose "Overlay into live env"), because the host only runs the env whose version equals its build and a package-install supersede stops adopted reviewers. The files import only API 12.101.15 ships, so a long-lived worker that rediscovers the pack cannot hit a missing core symbol. New and idle-retired workers load it; warm workers keep their registry until they retire. The next package-install replaces the overlay with the real 12.102.0 env.

The self-updater was disabled (HOOKS_UPDATE_ENABLED=false in ~/.claude/settings.json env, owner chose "Disable updater, then merge") so the auto-tagged release does not auto-supersede the host.
